desc: Ideation: choose convolution-based counting (answer = sum over B in S of (pair-sum-count at 2B minus 1)/2).
Implement numpy.fft self-convolution solution (L = next pow2 > 2*maxS, rfft/irfft of indicator, round to int64, answer = (sum over B in S of conv[2B] - N)//2).
Add pure-Python big-integer packing fallback (24-bit/3-byte slots) triggered if numpy import fails.
